2611.21111.title: Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations
2611.21111.paper_summary: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.
2611.21111.author: Thomas Woehrle et.al.
